quest.title: Good Medicine Is Difficult to Make
quest.description: Zakariya seems to be having some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Oh! Traveler! Come over here, I'd like to ask a favor of you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Do you remember Maruf, the doctor from Aaru Village? He sent you to get a prescription from me last time.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The poor guy brewed a medicine, tasted it, and ended up retching and vomiting for days.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: He said that the original prescription didn't work, so he sought to improve it.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: What in Teyvat did he do to find himself in this miserable state?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: *sigh* He must've done more than just adjusting the brewing method and modifying the amount of ingredients used.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: This is not the first time it's happened. Maruf just can't learn his lesson, can he?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Forget it. Perhaps he ran into some difficulties.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you get some raw ingredients for me? I'll brew a soup myself. Please bring it to Maruf.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Maruf adjusted the prescription that I gave him for treating headaches.

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: I still need three Henna Berries. Could you get them for me?

choices.text: You mean he's done something like this before?

response.speaker: Zakariya
response.text: Yeah, I can't remember how many times. Luckily, he seldom handles poisonous ingredients. Otherwise...

talks.objective: Give the Henna Berries to Zakariya

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: T—Traveler, what brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Zakariya sent me here.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: So you must've heard about the mess I've made. This is embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anyway, drink the medicine first.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Maruf drinks the medicine...

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Phew... I feel much better. Zakariya's indeed a great doctor.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you modify the prescription?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Do you remember the medicine we brewed together last time? It didn't work very well.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I thought I might've boiled it the wrong way or missed a few ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: So I... Um... made another bowl based on my experience.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I tried it first as a reasonable precaution, and I believe you know the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I just sent someone to get some medicine for me from Dr. Zakariya, but you beat him to the punch.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. I'm going to get some rest now. After that I'll have to start receiving patients again.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I've been absent for so long... Many villagers must be waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I'm running out of herbs again...
